meaning: Every existing Ontic interpretation has an expansion with exactly the same frame, existence and causes satisfying the existing explanation-factivity, existence-fact token coverage, rigid-token stability and existence-guarded reason invariance clauses. A property of Ontic holds for all such enriched models exactly when it already holds for all Ontic interpretations. On the unchanged fixedEffects ontology, weak intrinsic-tag coverage coexists with a necessary externally caused effect and a necessary cause. On unchanged alternatingEffects, it coexists with an actually contingent effect whose token cannot explain its absent-world existence. This is conservative weak-token enrichment, not adequate intrinsic explanation or a defense or refutation of a metaphysical PSR.
